d: Would you like to work for a forward-thinking technology company?
Join our Industrial & Energy Technology Team!

Our Industrial & Energy Technology (IET) business operates across 120 countries, serving the entire energy value chain and industrial sector. We offer an extensive portfolio of rotating equipment, process flow, transmission technology, and lifecycle services, helping our customers improve productivity, efficiency, and reliability.

As a Centrifugal Compressor Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for executing and supporting field service activities at customer sites. Working closely with project managers, service teams, and customers, you will ensure that installation, maintenance, commissioning, and start-up activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with contractual requirements.
As a Centrifugal Compressor Field Service Engineer, you will be responsible for:
Ensuring compliance with contractual requirements in close coordination with Baker Hughes Project and Service Managers.
Leading and executing field service activities on centrifugal compressor equipment.
Performing minor and major maintenance activities, including Dry Gas Seal (DGS) maintenance.
Supporting and executing unit start-up activities.
Preparing field service jobs and interventions in coordination with project managers.
Supervising equipment installation, maintenance, and commissioning activities.
Preparing accurate and professional service reports and acting as a key point of contact between customers and Baker Hughes Engineering teams for technical matters.
Using company electronic tools and systems to retrieve technical documentation and manage packing lists, bills of materials, and engineering drawings.
Ensuring all field activities are performed safely and in compliance with company Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies and procedures.
r: Have a two-year technical degree or equivalent qualification (preferred).
Have industry experience working with rotating equipment.
Possess basic knowledge of the oil and gas industry.
Demonstrate good mechanical aptitude and a willingness to learn.
Have the ability to work effectively as part of a team.
Be willing to travel and work at customer sites as required.
Work under direct supervision, following detailed instructions and completing the required on-the-job training.
Learn and assist other crew members during installation and maintenance activities at customer sites.
Develop practical knowledge of rotating equipment installation, inspection, and maintenance activities.
Work closely with assigned mentors, supervisors, and experienced field specialists to develop technical competencies.
Execute assigned responsibilities safely and in accordance with supervisor instructions, applicable service processes, and procedures.
Perform other related duties as required.
All activities must be conducted in accordance with Baker Hughes HSE policies, legal compliance requirements, and Core Values.
Work in a Way That Works for You
We recognize that everyone is different, and the way people work and deliver their best can vary. In this role, we offer a flexible working arrangement that supports work-life balance.
This position involves working at customer sites based on project assignments. Upon completion of assignments, you will have designated rest periods at home before taking on your next project.
Our people are at the heart of everything we do at Baker Hughes. We believe we achieve more when our people feel valued, supported, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work.
We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, provide opportunities for continuous learning and development, and recognize and reward talent at every level.
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. To continue shaping the future, we encourage people who embrace innovation, challenge conventional thinking, and drive meaningful change.
When you join Baker Hughes, you can expect
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities.
